7.11.3 Handling Errors during Startup and Shutdown
[SWS_EcuM_02980] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386
⌈The ECU Manager module shall ignore all types of errors that occur during initialization, e.g. values returned by init functions⌋ Initialization is a configuration issue (see EcuMDriverInitListZero , EcuMDriverInitListOne and EcuMDriverRestartList ) and therefore cannot be standardized. BSW modules are responsible themselves for reporting errors occurring during their initialization directly to the DEM module or the DET module, as specified in their SWSs. The ECU Manager module does not report the errors. The BSW module is also responsible for taking any special measures to react to errors occurring during their initialization.
